activeRecallQuiz.scenario: A stock forms a head and shoulders top pattern, but instead of breaking the neckline at ₹300, price surges above the right shoulder high at ₹340 on heavy volume. What does this failed pattern signal according to Murphy?
activeRecallQuiz.question: A stock forms a head and shoulders top pattern, but instead of breaking the neckline at ₹300, price surges above the right shoulder high at ₹340 on heavy volume. What does this failed pattern signal according to Murphy?
activeRecallQuiz.correctAnswer: Failed Pattern / Bullish Continuation Squeeze: When price rallies above the right shoulder peak without violating the neckline, trapped bears panic-cover, sparking a sharp and explosive resumption of the dominant uptrend.
activeRecallQuiz.explanation: Applying grounded principles prevents catastrophic losses and capital depletion.

coreTakeaways: Always evaluate underlying market assumptions before entering positions.
Separate gross theoretical payoff from real-world net profit.
Follow disciplined risk and position sizing limits on every trade.
